title: Delete the Website Logo | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Delete the Website Logo Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098255 A website logo can be removed whether it was uploaded as an image or created using the Logo Designer . Deleting an Uploaded Logo Image If the website logo was uploaded as an image: Log in to the Admin Area. Navigate to Settings → General Settings . Open the Brand Images tab. Scroll to the Website Logo section. Click the red X to remove the current logo. Alternatively, click Replace Image to upload a new logo. Note: After removing the logo image, the website title will automatically be displayed in its place. You can learn more about the Website Logo settings here: Settings » General Settings » Brand Images Tab Deleting a Text-Based Logo If the website uses the Logo Designer instead of an uploaded image: Navigate to Settings → Design Settings . Open the Logo Designer section. Clear the contents of both the Logo Designer and Logo Slogan fields. Click Save Changes . You can learn more about the "Logo Designer" settings here: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000045051 For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
